issues: React warning: Invalid DOM property fetchpriority — should be fetchPriority (camelCase) in JSX. Non-blocking but noisy in console (3 occurrences).

action_items: Minor: in Hero.jsx line 39, change fetchpriority="high" to fetchPriority="high" to silence React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx uses lowercase fetchpriority attribute which React 18 flags as invalid DOM prop; use camelCase fetchPriority in JSX (browser still receives it as fetchpriority).
ServicePage.jsx goQuote() uses setTimeout(800) + scrollIntoView which depends on React render completion — could race on slow devices; consider waiting on a state flag or using location.hash.
